messages:
nina: FYI ran into a subtle parity issue while testing the embeddings + rerank sample app across SDKs. batching helper pads up to next batch size, but when auth refresh triggers a retry one item comes back with a shorter vector.

nina: short repro: send 2 docs, helper pads to 4, expire token so the client refreshes then retries. response has 4 items but the last embedding is missing one float (1535 vs expected 1536).

nina: node snippet for context:
```js
// using devex-batcher v0.5.0
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-1536', input: ['d1','d2'] });
```

art: interesting. do you see the pad flag on the request body? some helpers tag padded rows like { _pad: true } while others strip them.

nina: yes request shows pad_index=3 in batcher log: 
```
[batcher] build id=7 size=4 pads=2 pad_indices=[2,3]
[auth] 401 -> refresh -> retry
[batcher] replaying 7
```

liam: my suspicion: when the batch is replayed the metadata that marks pads is mutated or lost, so the runtime still computes outputs for the full batch but the client assumes certain indices will be stripped. if reassembly logic doesn't sanity-check lengths you get silent truncation.

nina: server reply (truncated):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1535 floats...]}], "model":"embed-1536"}
```

art: two short-term fixes: (1) SDK should validate each returned embedding length against model profile and fail loudly if mismatch; (2) batch helper should deep-copy pad metadata into the retry record so replay is deterministic.

liam: agreed. long-term: runtime should include explicit response metadata: top-level "embedding_dim" and per-item "origin_index" so clients can remap even if ordering/filters changed. that also helps rerank where score arrays depend on index alignment.

nina: i've filed DE-4999 with logs + minimal repro and attached a small script to force token expiry during batch sends. ops-bot created the issue.

ops-bot: created issue DE-4999: "batcher pad metadata lost after auth-retry -> short embedding" and attached logs.

art: i'll push a patch to devex-batcher v0.5.1 that snapshots pad flags at enqueue and adds embedding length assertion. will include a non-breaking error message: "EmbeddingShapeError: expected 1536 got 1535 (req req-abc123)".

liam: i'll request eng-runtime to add embedding_dim in the /v1/embeddings response body and include request_id in the body for easier correlation. cc @eng-runtime.

nina: test plan: two SDKs (node/python) x batch sizes 2..8 x pad positions (head/mid/tail) x token-expiry-in-middle = should produce zero shape mismatches. adding as CI scenario.

art: i'll post canary link once tests pass. thanks for catching this, nina.

nina: thanks all. i'll update DE-4999 with CI results and close once canary + runtime change land.
